target_file: FTO Image Generator preset edit workflow
status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Make preset buttons more visually distinct and expose a clear workflow for updating a loaded preset or starting a new one.
assumptions: Loading a preset enters edit mode for that preset.
Saving with the loaded preset name updates it in place.
Changing the name saves a separate preset.
The existing localStorage schema remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Track loaded preset edit state
tasks.summary: Show update mode after loading and let users clear it to create a new preset.
verify: Loaded preset uses the Change Save label.
New Preset clears the active selection.

tasks.title: Make clickable preset cards visually distinct
tasks.summary: Display preset names and action states in a card-like load button with a clear selected style.
verify: Each item shows an action label.
The active item is visually distinct.

tasks.title: Regenerate standalone browser bundle
tasks.summary: Build the browser bundle with the edit workflow.

tasks.title: Run preset workflow and regression checks
tasks.summary: Verify hooks and run the full test suite.
